mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (reservation_no, user_id, room_id, reserve_date, start_time, end_time, topic, attendee_count, contact, purpose, status) VALUES (#{reservationNo}, #{userId}, #{roomId}, #{reserveDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{topic}, #{attendeeCount}, #{contact}, #{purpose}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT reservation_no FROM reservation WHERE reservation_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') ORDER BY reservation_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
